scenarios.name: New customer greeting - casual
scenarios.last_reply:
Hey, welcome back! 😊 Quick version: we stock melamine chipboard, MDF, UV gloss, and plywood — all cut to size. Our bestseller is White Melamine Chipboard 16mm, great for cabinets and cupboards.

What are you building? Once I know that, I can point you to the right board and give you pricing straight away.
